_doc: Hand-maintained corrections for .github/scripts/gen_data_connectors.py (see its docstring). Per connector: category / region / title / desc / name, key_required (true ONLY when the connector cannot return data without its key - decided by reading the script and checked with a keyless smoke run), key_note, docs_url, default_command / default_args, args_hints, commands / commands_add / commands_drop, ttl_sec, mcp (false = a dedicated MCP tool already covers it, or the connector must not be offered to agents) and broken (why the upstream does not work; the connector stays browsable in the UI but gets no MCP tool). params: typed arguments per command - {"<command>": [<param>, ...]} replaces the inferred list (null = unknown), {"<command>": {"<param>": {fields}}} patches inferred params by name ({"<param>": null} drops one), {"*": {"<param>": {fields}}} patches that name in every command; a <param> is {name, required, default, kind (string|int|float|date|enum|symbol|country|bool), choices?, help?, named?, variadic?}. sample: {"command", "args"} - the keyless call the Data Sources tab runs to show the connector (verified through fincept_connector.py run: ok, rows, under 20 s), or null when every command needs a key; without it the generator uses default_command + default_args for a connector that is not key_required. Regenerate after editing: python .github/scripts/gen_data_connectors.py

exclude.akshare_data.py: Served by the AkShare screen; endpoints resolve dynamically (getattr), not a fixed command list.
exclude.screener_data.py: Backs the Equity Screener (services/screener/ScreenerService); takes JSON criteria on stdin, not a generic `<command> [args]` connector.
exclude.equity_research_data.py: Backs the Equity Research screen (the C++ calls it by name); its dispatcher (`cmd == X and len(args) >= N`) is not readable by the generator. Excluded 2026-11-16 to unblock regeneration (it was never catalogued) - its owner may catalogue it instead with explicit `commands`.
